evidence.title: Pi-Vis v0.5.9 README
evidence.finding: The application bundles unmodified Pi, runs independent parallel sessions, optionally creates a Git worktree per session, and includes a diff viewer. Released installers target Apple Silicon macOS; Intel requires a source build. The browser dev renderer is a stub preview, not a separately released browser client.

evidence.title: Pi-Vis official product documentation
evidence.locator: Sections No second agent loop; No accounts, no server; Sessions in parallel; Install
evidence.finding: The site explicitly describes a local GUI around the bundled Pi runtime, one Pi process per session, no app-vendor account/server, and Apple Silicon-only release downloads. It distinguishes Pi extensions/config from the GUI.

evidence.title: Pi-Vis concrete Pi launch integration
evidence.finding: Electron main forks a Pi-session host, which imports the pinned bundled Pi runtime and calls createAgentSessionServices, createAgentSessionFromServices and createAgentSessionRuntime. Pi is the actual coding harness. Model-provider labels are not additional coding agents.

evidence.title: Pi-Vis bundled Pi dependency
evidence.finding: The application version is0.5.9 and the bundled Pi coding-agent dependency is pinned to 1.4.0. The app README says it exclusively uses that bundled runtime.

evidence.title: Pi-Vis provider-login implementation
evidence.locator: bridge.mjs modelAccess login lines 55–68 and loginProvider handler2050–2089
evidence.finding: The visible provider-auth path checks the live Pi provider and its OAuth/API-key login method, creates a product authentication interaction and calls Pi runtime login. Provider support is taken from the bundled runtime, not guessed from model names.

evidence.title: Pi-Vis displayed source diff
evidence.locator: Original site/assets/screenshots/diff.png, Changes pane for src/queue/consumer.ts
evidence.finding: Opened exact pixels display removed Redis blpop/requeue lines and added backoffMs import, PROMOTE_BATCH, promoteDue function and delayed-queue source code. This is actual code content in the real renderer, not merely four-file counts. Vendor seeded sample data is disclosed separately.

evidence.title: Pi-Vis source of product images
evidence.finding: The vendor screenshot script drives the actual React app with a preview-stub backend, seeds a fictional tidepool service and captures the renderer. It draws macOS traffic-light dots into the titlebar because browser preview lacks native window chrome. These are renderer/sample images, not a captured live packaged agent run.

evidence.title: Pi-Vis application MIT grant
evidence.locator: LICENSE, MIT License and permission grant
evidence.finding: The main application repository is MIT licensed, free of charge. Bundled third-party runtime/theme notices have separate attribution and are not a separate hosted-service license.

evidence.title: Inspected repository metadata
evidence.finding: Repository rsingapuri/pi-vis has archived=false. This field alone does not establish an active product or service.

evidence.title: Default-branch commit snapshot
evidence.finding: Default-branch head ad26c2c44bcf5f3293f8904dc0fae3601017a959 has committer timestamp 2026-10-26T07:36:30Z. This is repository activity, not a service availability test.

evidence.locator: Four returned issue/PR rows, specifically open PRs 3 and 4 and their body descriptions
evidence.finding: Open PR 3 proposes a display for the underlying pi-subagents extension fleet and PR 4 adds stop controls on top of it. The preserved listing does not show these proposals as merged or released, and neither supplies a separate product-owned coordinating-agent role.
